evidence: The paper uses random forests for spatial interpolation (via RFSI methodology) but does not extract or discuss variable importance. Covariates are selected a priori based on domain knowledge: "DEM, TWI, GTT, DOY, IDW" for temperature modeling, with similar choices for other meteorological variables. Hyperparameters (mtry, min.node.size, sample.fraction, n.obs) are tuned using nested 5-fold leave-location-out cross-validation optimizing RMSE. Accuracy is validated through cross-validation metrics (R², CCC, MAE, RMSE), comparison with the E-OBS dataset, and independent testing on stations not used in model training. No importance scores, feature rankings, or p-value tests are reported.
